feature.name: Near-infinite creature tokens for all players

almostIncluded.description:
Cast Plague of Vermin by paying {6}{B}.
Resolve Plague of Vermin, choosing to pay all but one life and create that many black Rat tokens.
For each Rat tokens that enters the battlefield, Ayara triggers, causing you to gain that many life and each opponent to lose that many life.
almostIncluded.notablePrerequisites: You have higher life total than your opponents.

almostIncluded.description:
Activate Marrow-Gnawer by tapping it and sacrificing another Rat.
When the Rat dies, Marrow-Gnawer triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve the Marrow-Gnawer ability from step 1, creating a number of 1/1 Rat creature tokens equal to the number of Rats you control.
Repeat.
almostIncluded.easyPrerequisites: You control at least one additional Rat.

almostIncluded.description:
Cast Plague of Vermin by paying {6}{B}, causing you to pay life equal to the highest life total your opponents have and create that many 1/1 Rat creature tokens.
Mirkwood Bats triggers for each token created this way, causing each opponent to lose that much life.
Each opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.
almostIncluded.notablePrerequisites: You have the highest life total.

feature.name: Infinitely large creature until end of turn

almostIncluded.description:
Activate Lightning Greaves's equip ability by paying {0}, targeting any creature you control except the creature that has Lightning Greaves attached.
Crackdown Construct triggers, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Resolve Lightning Greaves's equip ability.
Repeat.

Activate Spawnsire of Ulamog's first ability by paying {4}.
Illusionist's Bracers triggers, copying Spawnsire of Ulamog's first ability.
Resolve the copy of Spawnsire of Ulamog's first ability and Spawnsire of Ulamog's first ability, creating four Eldrazi Spawn tokens with "Sacrifice this creature: add {C} to your mana pool".
Activate the four Eldrazi Spawn tokens's abilites by sacrificing the Eldrazi Spawn, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.
almostIncluded.notablePrerequisites: Illusionist's Bracers is attached to Spawnsire of Ulamog.

feature.name: Infinitely large creature until end of turn

almostIncluded.description:
Activate Crypt Rats by paying {0}.
Crackdown Construct triggers, giving itself +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

template.name: Permanent Castable for {C}
template.scryfallQuery: mv<=1 (mana={0} or mana={1} or mana={C}) is:permanent

almostIncludedByAddingColors.description:
Activate Sol Ring by tapping it, adding {C} {C}.
Cast the permanent that can be cast using {C} by paying its mana cost.
Hullbreaker Horror triggers, returning Sol Ring from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Sol Ring by paying {1}. 
Hullbreaker Horror triggers, returning the permanent cast in step 2 from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
If the permanent can be cast by paying {0}, this combo nets infinite colorless mana.

Cast Sol Ring by paying its mana cost.
Tidespout Tyrant triggers, returning a nontoken permanent that can be cast using {C} from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Sol Ring by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Cast the nontoken permanent returned in step 2 by paying its mana cost.
Tidespout Tyrant triggers, returning Sol Ring from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
almostIncludedByAddingColors.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken permanent that can be cast using {C}.

almostIncludedByAddingColors.notes: You want to reduce the affinity creature's cost by {2} or more using its affinity ability. For example, if you choose Ancestral Statue, you need to control two or more attacking creatures.

template.name: Creature with Affinity
template.scryfallQuery: (keyword:affinity or otag:affinity or !"Emrakul, the Promised End") t:creature

almostIncludedByAddingColors.description:
Activate Lightning Greaves's equip ability by paying {0}, targeting the affinity creature.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending the targeted creature.
The Lightning Greaves ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast the creature from exile by paying {0} due to its affinity ability.
Repeat.
almostIncludedByAddingColors.easyPrerequisites: You are able to reduce the affinity creature's cost by {2} or more.

feature.name: Infinite mana artifacts you control can produce
Infinite mana creatures you control can produce
Infinite untap of artifacts you control
Infinite untap of creatures you control

almostIncludedByAddingColors.description:
Activate Aphetto Alchemist by tapping it, targeting itself.
Illusionist's Bracers triggers, copying Aphetto Alchemist's ability targeting any other artifact or creature.
Resolve both Aphetto Alchemist abilities, untapping it and the second target.
Repeat.
almostIncludedByAddingColors.notablePrerequisites:
Illusionist's Bracers attached to Aphetto Alchemist.
Aphetto Alchemist does not have summoning sickness.

feature.name: Infinite mana creatures you control can produce
Infinite untap of creatures you control

almostIncludedByAddingColors.description:
Activate Seeker of Skybreak by tapping it, targeting itself.
Illusionist's Bracers triggers, copying Seeker of Skybreak's ability targeting any other creature you control.
Resolve both triggers, untapping Seeker of Skybreak and another creature you control.
Repeat.
almostIncludedByAddingColors.notablePrerequisites:
Seeker of Skybreak does not have summoning sickness.
Illusionist's Bracer attached to Seeker of Skybreak.

almostIncludedByAddingColors.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token that gets +1/+1 for each other Squirrel on the battlefield.
The Squirrel enters the battlefield, triggering Scurry Oak's evolve ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Repeat from step 2.
almostIncludedByAddingColors.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
The number of Squirrels on the battlefield is greater than Scurry Oak's power.

almostIncludedByAddingColors.description:
Activate Lightning Greaves's equip ability by paying {0}, targeting Cephalid Illusionist.
Cephalid Illusionist triggers, causing you to mill three cards.
Resolve the Lightning Greaves ability, attaching it to Cephalid Illusionist.
Repeat.

feature.name: Infinite mana permanents you control can produce

almostIncludedByAddingColors.description:
Activate Tidewater Minion's last ability by tapping it, targeting itself.
Illusionist's Bracers triggers, copying the Tidewater Minion ability, targeting any other permanent.
Resolve both Tidewater Minion abilities, untapping Tidewater Minion and the other target.
Activate that permanent by tapping it for mana or other results if possible.
Repeat.
almostIncludedByAddingColors.notablePrerequisites:
Tidewater Minion does not have summoning sickness.
Illusionist's Bracers attached to Tidewater Minion.

feature.name: Infinite mana creatures you control can produce

almostIncludedByAddingColors.description:
Activate Marrow-Gnawer by tapping it and sacrificing another Rat, creating at least two 1/1 Rat tokens.
Intruder Alarm triggers once for each creature token created, untapping all creatures that many times.
Repeat.
almostIncludedByAddingColors.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional Rats.

feature.name: Infinite mana lands you control can produce
Infinite untap of lands you control

almostIncludedByAddingColors.description:
Activate Nykthos' second ability by paying {2} and tapping it, causing you to add eleven mana of any color with which you have devotion.
Activate Silvanus's Invoker by paying {8}, causing Nykthos to become an 8/8 Elemental with haste until end of turn, and untapping it.
Repeat.
almostIncludedByAddingColors.notablePrerequisites: You have at least eleven devotion to any color.

feature.name: Infinite mana lands you control can produce

almostIncludedByAddingColors.description:
Activate Nykthos by paying {2} and tapping it, adding at least eight {G}.
Activate Wakeroot Elemental by paying {G}{G}{G}{G}{G}, untapping Nykthos and causing it to become a 5/5 Elemental creature with haste until end of turn that is still a land.
Repeat.
almostIncludedByAddingColors.notablePrerequisites: Your devotion to green is at least eight.

almostIncludedByAddingColors.description:
Activate Marrow-Gnawer by tapping it and sacrificing another Rat.
When the Rat dies, Faces of the Past triggers, untapping all Rats.
Resolve the Marrow-Gnawer ability, creating a 1/1 Rat creature token for each Rat you control.
Repeat.

Activate Lightning Greaves's equip ability by paying {0}, targeting Cephalid Aristocrat.
Cephalid Aristocrat triggers, causing you to mill two cards.
Resolve Lightning Greaves's ability, attaching it to Cephalid Aristrocrat.
Activate Lightning Greaves's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to another creature you control.
Repeat.

feature.name: Infinite mana permanents you control can produce

almostIncludedByAddingColors.description:
Activate Sol Ring by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Rimewind Taskmage by paying {1} and tapping it, targeting itself.
Illusionist's Bracers triggers, copying Rimewind Taskmage's ability, targeting Sol Ring.
Resolve both abilities, untapping Rimewind Taskmage and Sol Ring.
Repeat.
almostIncludedByAddingColors.notablePrerequisites:
Illusionist's Bracers attached to Rimewind Taskmage.
Rimewind Taskmage does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least four snow permanents.

almostIncludedByAddingColors.description:
Activate Crypt Rats by paying {B}, dealing 1 damage to each player and creature.
Smaug triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.
almostIncludedByAddingColors.notablePrerequisites: Crypt Rats is indestructible, has protection from black, or has protection from creatures.

feature.name: Infinite copies of one instant or sorcery

template.name: Instant or Sorcery that untaps a Creature
template.scryfallQuery: (t:instant or t:sorcery) o:"untap " (o:creature -o:"nonlegendary creature" or o:permanent -o:"noncreature permanent") -o:destroy

almostIncludedByAddingColors.description:
Cast the instant or sorcery by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, activate Stella Lee by tapping it, copying the instant or sorcery.
Resolve the copy of the instant or sorcery, untapping Stella Lee.
Repeat from step 2.
almostIncludedByAddingColors.notablePrerequisites:
You have cast at least two spells this turn.
Stella Lee does not have summoning sickness.
You have enough mana to cast the instant or sorcery card.
You have additional legal target(s) for the instant or sorcery card, if applicable.

almostIncludedByAddingColors.notes: Moritte can only be your commander if the sources from both templates fit within its commander identity.
almostIncludedByAddingColors.description:
Cast Moritte either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{G}{U}{U} plus commander tax if applicable. Choose to have it enter as a copy of the persist creature that is still legendary.
Put Moritte into your graveyard due to the legend rule. When it dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it due to its ability. Choose to have it enter as a copy of the persist creature that is still legendary.
Repeat step 2.
almostIncludedByAddingColors.notablePrerequisites: The persist creature is your Ring-bearer.
